body.anaDetail: No AI provider is configured. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or AI_BEDROCK_ENABLED / AI_VERTEX_ENABLED) — without one, every AnA turn returns 503 GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE. OPENAI_API_KEY or KIMI_API_KEY alone answer chat but not regulatory drafting, which only an approvedForHighRisk model may serve.

steps.title: Prerequisite: a program with one vault document
Create a submission and its first sequence
steps.action: POST /api/c2c/projects; POST /api/submissions {programId, IND, biotech, fda}; POST /api/submissions/:id/sequences {fda, "0000", original}; GET sequences
steps.expected: HTTP 201 for both; the audit outcome is reported on the submission; the sequence is listed with status draft

steps.title: Place a vault document as an eCTD leaf
steps.action: POST /api/vault/ingest a cover letter into the submission's own program; PUT /api/submissions/sequences/:seq/leaves {sectionCode:"m1.2", title, documentTable:"vault_documents", documentUuid}; the same with OQ-SUBC-00's document, which belongs to another program; GET leaves
steps.expected: HTTP 200; the leaf is listed with its section code; a document of another project is refused 409 CROSS_PROJECT; an unplaceable documentTable is refused with 400
steps.observed: leaf placed ({"id":8,"sequenceId":11,"sectionCode":"m1.2","title":"Cover letter","granularity":null,"lifecycleOp":"new","documentTable":"vault_documents","documentId":null,"); another project's document → 409 CROSS_PROJECT; bad table → 400
steps.note: A filing holds only its own project's documents (PF-11, 2026-09-26). Since OQ-SUBC-03 gives the submission a program of its own (LX-22), the document placed is ingested into that program; OQ-SUBC-00's document, in another program, is the refused case.

steps.title: Sequence lifecycle follows the state machine
steps.action: POST transition draft→assembling; then assembling→dispatched (skips validated)
steps.expected: First transition 200 (status assembling); second refused (INVALID_STATE or GOVERNED_REQUIRED), status unchanged

steps.title: Freeze and dispatch are governed transitions only
steps.action: POST transition {status:"frozen"} on the generic endpoint; POST /sequences/:id/freeze without signatureActionId
steps.expected: Generic transition refused with GOVERNED_REQUIRED; freeze without a signature refused with 400 VALIDATION
steps.observed: generic frozen → 403 GOVERNED_REQUIRED; freeze w/o signatureActionId → 400

steps.title: Governed e-signature demands re-authentication
steps.action: POST /api/c2c/actions/sign {target:"ectd-sequence:<id>", reason} with no reauth block
steps.expected: Refused (4xx) with a re-authentication error; no signature or ledger action created
steps.observed: HTTP 400: {"error":"SIGNATURE_MEANING_REQUIRED","detail":"One of: APPROVED, REVIEWED, RESPONSIBILITY, AUTHORSHIP, authorship, review, approval, responsibility, release, retirement."}

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: sign the sequence under a Part 11 e-signature; freeze is then decided by the composed gate, not by the signature alone
steps.action: sign in as OQ_SIGNER_EMAIL with its password (and its authenticator code where the server requires MFA); when the signer has a second factor enrolled (OQ_SIGNER_TOTP_SECRET), first POST /api/c2c/actions/sign with reauth:{password} only; then POST /api/c2c/actions/sign {target:"ectd-sequence:<id>", reason, payload:{intent:"freeze", meaning:"approval"}, reauth:{password, totp}}; GET /api/part11/signatures/by-target; POST /sequences/:id/freeze {signatureActionId} as the signer
steps.expected: A signer with a second factor enrolled: the password-only signature is refused 401 REAUTH_TOTP_REQUIRED and writes no signature row (§11.200). Sign: HTTP 200 with actionId; exactly one electronic_signatures row on ectd-sequence:<id> by the signer, second_factor_verified true when a code was presented. Freeze on this never-validated sequence (status assembling after OQ-SUBC-04): refused 409 INVALID_STATE by the sequence state machine (a valid e-signature is necessary, not sufficient); the sequence status is unchanged. Without OQ_SIGNER_EMAIL / OQ_SIGNER_PASSWORD the step is recorded "not executed — credential not supplied".
steps.observed: password-only signature refused 401 REAUTH_TOTP_REQUIRED with no row written; signed with password + TOTP; sign → actionId act_88e251e68223423d9b15f5bec7249ee6 (executed); 1 electronic_signatures row (id 58, approval, second_factor_verified true); freeze → 409 INVALID_STATE (Cannot transition sequence from assembling to frozen. The signature given for this freeze is now void; sign again for a new attempt.); sequence status assembling unchanged
steps.note: The sign action re-authenticates with the account password (verifyReauth) and applies separation of duties (the signer must not be the sequence's creator — the run identity). freezeSequence checks the state machine, then the signature, then the deterministic gate; a frozen outcome needs a validated, shadow-reviewed sequence, which this protocol's fixture is not. What is qualified here is the signature persistence and that a signature alone does not freeze.

steps.title: Gateway capabilities are reported honestly
steps.expected: Every gateway reports configured:false in this environment (no ESG/CESP credentials); no gateway is claimed as configured

steps.title: Canonical dossier for the accepted project
steps.expected: HTTP 200 with governed readiness and independent artifact/tracking states
steps.observed: HTTP 200: program 06f08b30-e632-4499-8374-e9dc4e0fce42; governed measured; artifacts no_artifacts; tracking no_sections
steps.note: v0.8: the step reads the dossier as it is answered. The protocol was written at 8b192f1e75 (2026-10-26) and, before it was ever executed, 117a3591ac and 01dbd4eb38 (the same day) moved artifactReadiness to the top of the response and named each read outcome: measured, no_artifacts / no_sections (read, nothing to count), unanchored (no project to read), unavailable (with a code and a reason). The step still requires every outcome to be stated and a failed read never to be a zero.

steps.title: eCTD compile answers for the program
steps.expected: Compile answers 2xx with a spine/status, or an explained 4xx refusal — never a 500

Submission Center surface renders the submission

steps.note: v0.8: since b1d7d85ec8 (2026-10-08, D2 ana-24) Submission Center lists the open project's submissions. OQ-SUBC-03 creates its submission on a project of its own (LX-22), and the step opened OQ-SUBC-00's, so the list was that project's.

steps.title: eCTD compile and publishing surfaces render
steps.expected: Both render (screenshots) without a runtime page error

steps.title: A Shadow Review waiver is offered only after a provider outage, and only by signature (P-34)
steps.action: POST /api/submissions/sequences/:id/shadow-review; GET …/shadow-review; GET …/dispatch-readiness; POST …/shadow-review/waive {signatureActionId:"oq-not-a-signature", failedRunId:<the newest run>}; GET …/shadow-review
steps.expected: dispatch-readiness reports shadowReviewWaiver.state "none". With no completed review: shadowReviewWaivable is present, and eligible only when the newest run failed as provider_unavailable or provider_overloaded (on this installation, with no provider configured, the run fails as no_provider_configured, which is not an outage: eligible false, with the reason), and the shadowPresence gate blocks. With a completed review: no waiver is offered and the gate clears with no note. Either way the waive without a signature is refused 4xx (403 GOVERNED_REQUIRED or 409 SHADOW_WAIVER_NOT_ELIGIBLE) and no run reads "waived". The positive path, an outage waived by a credentialed signer, is proven over the real act in server/services/ectd/__tests__/shadow-review-waiver.pglite.integration.test.ts; an installation cannot be made to suffer one on demand.
steps.observed: review POST 503; newest run #3 failed/no_provider_configured; waiver none; eligible=false (Run #3 failed because no AI provider is configured on this deployment, which is not an AI provider outage, so Shadow Review cannot be waived for it. Run Shadow Review again.); waive refused 403 GOVERNED_REQUIRED; no waived run
